entries.title: Lite Mode
entries.description: Strips YouTube down to a calmer, subscription-first, bare-bones experience.

entries.title: Remove ads
entries.description: Removes in-app ads.

entries.title: Hide Paid Promotion cards
entries.description: Hides "Includes Paid Promotions" card in promotions included videos.

entries.title: Hide search history
entries.description: Visually hides search history and suggestions. Note: Your search history will still be accessible in your other YouTube clients.

entries.title: Disable link tracking
entries.description: Prevents tracking information from being sent when tapping links. Opens links directly instead of going through Google redirects.

entries.title: Clean shared links
entries.description: Removes YouTube's extra share identifier from shared links.

entries.title: Hide Cast button
entries.description: Hides Cast button from the Navigation bar.

entries.title: Hide Notifications button
entries.description: Hides Notifications button from the Navigation bar.

entries.title: Hide Search button
entries.description: Hides Search button from the Navigation bar.

entries.title: Hide Voice search button
entries.description: Hides Voice search button from the Navigation bar.

entries.title: Sticky Navigation bar
entries.description: Pins the Navigation bar so that it remains visible when scrolling down.

entries.title: Hide Subbar
entries.description: Hides Subbar (All, New to you, Live etc.) under the Navigation bar.

entries.title: Hide YouTube logo
entries.description: Hides the YouTube logo from the Navigation bar.

entries.title: Premium YouTube logo
entries.description: Replaces the YouTube logo with the Premium logo.

entries.title: Opaque tab bar
entries.description: Makes the tab bar solid with no transparency.

entries.title: Disable floating tab bar
entries.description: Uses the full-width tab bar instead of YouTube's floating capsule. Restart YouTube to switch layouts.

entries.title: Remove tab labels
entries.description: Removes text labels from the Tab bar buttons.

entries.title: Remove tab indicators
entries.description: Removes notification indicators from the Tab bar.

entries.title: Bonus tab row
entries.description: Shows extra active tabs in a compact second row beneath the main bar.

entries.title: Centered side anchors
entries.description: Moves two selected native tabs to larger side positions, with the bonus row below the remaining native tabs. Defaults to Afterglow Control Center and Library. Requires Bonus tab row.

entries.title: Left side button
entries.description: Choose a native top-row tab for the larger left position.

entries.title: Right side button
entries.description: Choose a native top-row tab for the larger right position.

entries.title: Startup animation
entries.description: Displays YouTube startup loading animation.

entries.title: Legacy/iPad-style UI
entries.description: Uses the older YouTube interface mode that Floating Keyboard depends on.

entries.title: Floating keyboard
entries.description: Force-enables the floating keyboard. Requires Legacy/iPad-style UI on iPhone.

entries.title: Disable RTL formatting
entries.description: Forcefully displays text in left-to-right (LTR) format for languages that are initially displayed in right-to-left (RTL).

entries.title: Persistent progress bar
entries.description: Always shows progress bar in the player.

entries.title: Hide most replayed graph
entries.description: Removes the heatwave graph from the player seek bar.

entries.title: Enable glow
entries.description: Enables branded glow effects across selected UI surfaces.

entries.title: Glow pivot bar
entries.description: Applies glow styling to the pivot/tab bar.

entries.title: Glow overlay buttons
entries.description: Applies glow styling to overlay controls.

entries.title: Glow scrubber
entries.description: Applies glow styling to the seek scrubber thumb.

entries.title: Glow seek bar
entries.description: Applies glow styling to the seek bar track.

entries.title: Animate seek
entries.description: Adds subtle animation when the seek bar updates.

entries.title: Disable ambient mode
entries.description: Disables ambient mode both in the player and in the area underneath it.

entries.title: Seek bar gradient
entries.description: Enables gradient rendering for the seek bar.

entries.title: Enable
entries.description: Activates YTAfterglow's built-in SponsorBlock client.

entries.title: Enable for Shorts
entries.description: Automatically skips enabled SponsorBlock categories in Shorts.

entries.title: Show seekbar markers
entries.description: Draw SponsorBlock segment markers on the seek bar.

entries.title: Sponsor markers
entries.description: Show sponsor segments as markers on the seek bar.

entries.title: Interaction reminder markers
entries.description: Show interaction reminder segments on the seek bar.

entries.title: Self-promotion markers
entries.description: Show self-promotion segments on the seek bar.

entries.title: Intro markers
entries.description: Show intro segments on the seek bar.

entries.title: Outro markers
entries.description: Show outro and credit segments on the seek bar.

entries.title: Preview markers
entries.description: Show preview and recap segments on the seek bar.

entries.title: Hook markers
entries.description: Show opening hook segments on the seek bar.

entries.title: Filler markers
entries.description: Show filler and tangent segments on the seek bar.

entries.title: Non-music section markers
entries.description: Show non-music sections of music videos on the seek bar.

entries.title: Sponsor
entries.description: Part of a video promoting a product or service not directly related to the creator. The creator will receive payment or compensation in the form of money or free products

entries.title: Interaction reminders
entries.description: Explicit reminders to like, subscribe or interact with them on any paid or free platform(s) (e.g. click on a video)

entries.title: Unpaid/Self promotion
entries.description:
Self-promo: Promoting a product or service that is directly related to the creator themselves.
Unpaid:The creator will not receive any payment in exchange for this promotion

entries.title: Intermission/Intro animation
entries.description: Segments typically found at the start of a video that include an animation, still frame or clip which are also seen in other videos by the same creator.

entries.title: Endcards/Credits
entries.description: Typically near or at the end of the video when the credits pop up and/or endcards are shown.

entries.title: Preview
entries.description: Collection of clips that show what is coming up in in this video or other videos in a series where all information is repeated later in the video.

entries.title: Hook
entries.description: A brief opening section designed to keep viewers watching before the main content begins.

entries.title: Filler Tangent/Jokes
entries.description: Filler Tangent/Jokes is only for tangential scenes added only for filler or humor that are not required to understand the main content of the video.

entries.title: Music: Non-music section
entries.description: Only to be used on videos which feature music as the primary content.

entries.title: Background playback
entries.description: Enables background playback.

entries.title: Disable auto captions
entries.description: Prevents automatic activation of captions.

entries.title: Remember caption state
entries.description: Keeps your last subtitle preference instead of letting YouTube reset it.

entries.title: Remember loop mode
entries.description: Remembers the last selected loop mode in the player menu.

entries.title: Classic video quality
entries.description: Brings back classic video quality selection menu.

entries.title: Skip content warning
entries.description: Skips sensitive content warning message.

entries.title: Hide Continue Watching feed card
entries.description: Hides YouTube's "Continue watching" surface.

entries.title: Hide up-next panel
entries.description: Hides the up-next panel that appears below the player.

entries.title: Hide end-screen cards
entries.description: Hides End screens (thumbnails) at the end of videos.

entries.title: Hide end-screen related videos
entries.description: When a video ends in fullscreen, YouTube shows related video thumbnails on the player — this hides them.

entries.title: Hide resume-video prompt
entries.description: Disables the 'Are you still watching?' alert that pauses long sessions.

entries.title: Enable mini player
entries.description: Enables the mini player for videos that were not originally designed for it, such as videos targeted for children.

entries.title: Old playlist minibar
entries.description: Replaces the new floating playlist panel with the old one.

entries.title: Portrait fullscreen mode
entries.description: Enables portrait fullscreen mode support.

entries.title: Play videos in fullscreen
entries.description: Automatically plays videos in fullscreen mode.

entries.title: Exit fullscreen mode on finish
entries.description: Exits fullscreen mode at the end of video playback.

entries.title: Tap to seek
entries.description: Quickly jump to any point by tapping the progress bar.

entries.title: Disable double tap to seek
entries.description: Disables double tap to seek gesture.

entries.title: Disable two finger double tap
entries.description: Disables two finger double tap snap to chapter gesture.

entries.title: Disable snap to chapter
entries.description: Disables skipping to the next episode by double-tap gesture.

entries.title: Disable free zoom gesture
entries.description: Disables new free zoom gestures.

entries.title: Hide Download button
entries.description: Hides the Download button from the player.

entries.title: Remove "Share" button
entries.description: Removes "Share" button under player.

entries.title: Remove "Save" button
entries.description: Removes "Save" button under player.

entries.title: Hide Remix button
entries.description: Hides the Remix button from the player.

entries.title: Hide Clip button
entries.description: Hides the Clip button from the player.

entries.title: Remove "Download"
entries.description: Removes "Download" option from menu.

entries.title: Remove "Share"
entries.description: Removes "Share" option from menu.

entries.title: Mute button
entries.description: Displays a button to mute or unmute the volume on the overlay.

entries.title: Lock button
entries.description: Displays a button to quickly lock the overlay screen and switch to fullscreen mode.

entries.title: Download button
entries.description: Displays a button on the overlay to download the current video, audio, captions, or thumbnail.

entries.title: Premium controls button
entries.description: Displays a button on the overlay that opens Afterglow's rebuild of YouTube Premium's controls sheet with playback, speed, stable volume, and save tiles.

entries.title: Clean overlay button
entries.description: Adds the eye button to the player overlay. Each press cycles four modes: YouTube controls, Afterglow-only controls, timed controls with a faded eye, and fully timed; the fourth press returns to YouTube's controls. The mode resets on a fresh launch.

entries.title: Hide video title
entries.description: Hides the video title in fullscreen overlay.

entries.title: Hide Fullscreen button
entries.description: Hides the standard player's fullscreen button while preserving YouTube's native availability state.

entries.title: Hide More button
entries.description: Hides the three-dot More button from the standard player overlay.

entries.title: Hide YouTube Music button
entries.description: Hides the YouTube Music shortcut when YouTube provides it in the player overlay.

entries.title: Hide Collapse button
entries.description: Hides the player collapse control when YouTube makes it available.

entries.title: Hide Subtitles button
entries.description: Hides Subtitles button from the overlay.

entries.title: Hide HUD messages
entries.description: Hides HUD overlay messages in the player.

entries.title: Hide Previous and Next buttons
entries.description: Hides Previous and Next video buttons from overlay.

entries.title: Fast forward and Rewind buttons
entries.description: Replaces Previous and Next video buttons to Fast forward and Rewind buttons in overlay.

entries.title: Remove dark background
entries.description: Removes overlay dark background.

entries.title: Disable fullscreen actions
entries.description: Disables actions panel in fullscreen mode.

entries.title: Stock volume HUD
entries.description: Displays system volume HUD in fullscreen.

entries.title: Hide Watermarks
entries.description: Hides channel watermarks from the player.

entries.title: Show playback end time
entries.description: Adds video playback end time to the player bar.

entries.title: 24-hour format
entries.description: Shows end time in 24-hour format.

entries.title: Pause on overlay
entries.description: Pauses when overlay appears and resumes when it hides.

entries.title: Shorts only mode
entries.description: Limits YouTube functionality to viewing Shorts only.

entries.title: Auto-skip Shorts
entries.description: Automatically skips to the next Short.

entries.title: Hide Shorts videos
entries.description: Hides Shorts videos from Homepage, Recommended etc.

entries.title: Enable progress bar
entries.description: Displays progress bar in the Shorts overlay.

entries.title: Pinch to Fullscreen
entries.description: Manages visibility of the overlay with pinch in and pinch out gestures, displaying Shorts in fullscreen mode.

entries.title: Shorts to regular videos
entries.description: Opens Shorts videos as regular videos.

entries.title: Disable resume Shorts
entries.description: Prevents YouTube from resuming to Shorts on startup.

entries.title: Hide Shorts logo
entries.description: Hides Shorts logo in the top left corner.

entries.title: Hide Search button
entries.description: Hides Search button from the Shorts overlay.

entries.title: Hide Camera button
entries.description: Hides Camera button from the Shorts overlay.

entries.title: Hide More (⋮) button
entries.description: Hides More (⋮) button from the Shorts overlay. It's also accessible by long-pressing the screen.

entries.title: Hide Lens button
entries.description: Hides the Lens button in the Shorts overlay when YouTube 21.37 exposes it.

entries.title: Hide Subscriptions carousel
entries.description: Hides the Subscriptions carousel in Shorts.

entries.title: No Like button
entries.description: Removes the Like button from the action bar.

entries.title: No Dislike button
entries.description: Removes the Dislike button from the action bar.

entries.title: No Comments button
entries.description: Removes the Comments button from the action bar.

entries.title: No Remix button
entries.description: Removes the Remix button from the action bar.

entries.title: No Share button
entries.description: Removes the Share button from the action bar.

entries.title: Hide avatars
entries.description: Hides channel avatars from the Shorts overlay.

entries.title: Hide Thanks badge
entries.description: Hides the Thanks badge from Shorts.

entries.title: No source link button
entries.description: Removes the button that navigates to the full video or another Short video.

entries.title: Hide channel name
entries.description: Hides the channel name from Shorts.

entries.title: No description
entries.description: Removes the Shorts description.

entries.title: Hide audio track
entries.description: Hides the audio track info from Shorts.

entries.title: Hide Shorts promo cards
entries.description: Hides promotional cards inside the Shorts viewer.

entries.title: Hide info panel
entries.description: Hides the entire renderer-backed Shorts info panel, including its channel and description content.

entries.title: Hide metapanel
entries.description: Hides the entire renderer-backed Shorts metapanel when YouTube supplies one.

entries.title: Hide built-in player layer
entries.description: Hides YouTube's renderer-backed Shorts player layer while leaving Afterglow's overlay controls available.

entries.title: Refresh missing metadata
entries.description: If the live player data has no captions or extras, Afterglow checks YouTube again before showing the download sheet.

entries.title: Prefer stable volume
entries.description: Prefer YouTube's dynamic-range-compressed audio stream when both stable and original variants are available.

entries.title: Include auto captions
entries.description: Show auto-generated caption tracks in the captions picker.

entries.title: Offer translated captions
entries.description: Show YouTube-translated caption tracks when the video exposes translation languages.

entries.title: Remove "Play next in queue"
entries.description: Removes "Play next in queue" option from menu.

entries.title: Remove "Save to Watch Later"
entries.description: Removes "Save to Watch Later" option from menu.

entries.title: Remove "Save to playlist"
entries.description: Removes "Save to playlist" option from menu.

entries.title: Remove "Not interested"
entries.description: Removes "Not interested" option from menu.

entries.title: Remove "Don't recommend channel"
entries.description: Removes "Don't recommend channel" option from menu.

entries.title: Remove "Report"
entries.description: Removes "Report" option from menu.

entries.title: Copy video details
entries.description: Long press the video details panel to copy video details.

entries.title: Profile photo actions
entries.description: Long press profile pictures to save or copy them.

entries.title: Post actions
entries.description: Long press posts to copy text, save images, or copy the post as an image.

entries.title: Comment actions
entries.description: Long press comments to copy text or save them as an image.

entries.title: Use native share sheet
entries.description: Uses the iOS share sheet when sharing media.

entries.title: Fix album covers
entries.description: Fixes the display of covers for users from Russia.

entries.title: Copy timestamped links
entries.description: Allows to copy timestamped link to the clipboard by pressing pause button.

entries.title: Advanced mode
entries.description: Shows extra power-user settings and advanced UI controls.

entries.title: Debug logging
entries.description: Master switch for in-memory and on-disk diagnostic logs. Turning it off also turns off Firehose logging and the debug HUD.

entries.title: Firehose logging
entries.description: Turns on Debug logging and captures every Afterglow log category, including noisy internals and future categories.

entries.title: Downloads
entries.description: Capture download buttons, format extraction, stream downloads, FFmpeg, caption, thumbnail, and save-to-Photos logs.

entries.title: Player UI
entries.description: Capture player overlay, mute/lock buttons, Shorts overlay, fullscreen, and view-controller resolution logs.

entries.title: Premium controls
entries.description: Capture the pseudo-Premium controls sheet, action taps, speed controls, and related presentation logs.

entries.title: Picture in Picture
entries.description: Capture PiP compatibility and activation logs. Usually noisy, so it is off by default.

entries.title: Diagnostics
entries.description: Capture startup diagnostics, offline-download routing logs, initialization logs, and detailed compatibility events. Noisy and off by default.

entries.title: Show Debug HUD
entries.description: Floating on-screen overlay showing the latest log lines. Turning it on also enables Debug logging.

entries.title: Red Progress Bar
entries.description: Legacy option that paints the seek bar red when no theme color is set.

entries.title: Route Native Downloads
entries.description: Sends YouTube's own download button through Afterglow's downloader when native offline orchestration is available.

entries.title: Hold to speed
entries.description:
Sets the playback speed triggered by a long press on the player.

Standard: 0.25×–5× with fixed steps
Extended: 0.25×–10× with 0.05× steps

entries.title: Default playback rate
entries.description: Overrides the default playback speed

entries.title: Playback quality on WiFi
entries.description: Automatically applies the selected quality when streaming over Wi-Fi

entries.title: Playback quality on Cellular
entries.description: Automatically applies the selected quality when streaming over mobile data

entries.title: Autoplay
entries.description: Choose whether autoplay stays default, turns off, or turns off and hides the switch.

entries.title: Comments header
entries.description: Choose default behavior for the comments sort header.

entries.title: After download
entries.description: Choose whether completed videos save to Photos, open the share sheet, or ask every time.

entries.title: Audio track
entries.description: Choose the default audio track automatically, or ask when multiple language/dubbed tracks are available.

entries.title: Audio quality
entries.description: Use standard audio, or prefer higher-bitrate Premium audio when YouTube exposes it.

entries.title: Picker text size
entries.description: Controls the text size used by the video quality and audio track lists.

entries.title: Picker font
entries.description: Controls the font face used by the video quality and audio track lists.

entries.title: Scrubber Size
entries.description: Makes the seek bar scrubber ball bigger or smaller.

entries.title: Glow strength
entries.description: Controls glow intensity for enabled glow surfaces.

entries.title: Glow Strength Mode
entries.description: Chooses the subtle, normal, strong, or custom glow strength.

entries.title: Custom Glow Strength
entries.description: Exact glow strength from 0 to 100 used by the custom mode.

entries.title: Glow Opacity
entries.description: Maximum shadow opacity as a percentage.

entries.title: Glow Radius
entries.description: Radius multiplier where 50 is normal and 100 is double.

entries.title: Glow Layers
entries.description: Number of stacked glow passes. Higher values are louder and heavier.

entries.title: App font
entries.description: Applies the selected font across YouTube text. Auto keeps stock fonts unless Lite Mode is on. If font changes look off at first, restart the app.

entries.title: App font size
entries.description: Scales every original text size by the selected percentage so titles and supporting text keep their hierarchy.

entries.title: App font weight
entries.description: Adjusts each original weight relatively, preserving the difference between titles and supporting text.

entries.title: App font style
entries.description: Keep each original style, force upright text, or apply italics app-wide.

entries.title: Tab label size
entries.description: Shrinks tab labels when wider fonts would wrap names like Subscriptions.

entries.title: Startup Tab
entries.description: Choose which active tab opens first.

entries.title: Reset Player Overlay
entries.description: Returns the player overlay eye to YouTube's controls for this session without changing any saved preference.

entries.title: Reset All Colors
entries.description: Clear every theme override and go back to stock colors.

entries.title: Export Preferences
entries.description: Share a YTAfterglow preferences file you can import later.

entries.title: Import Preferences
entries.description: Replace the current setup with a saved YTAfterglow preferences file.

entries.title: Restore default settings
entries.description: Restores every Afterglow preference to its default.

entries.title: Clear cache
entries.description: Deletes cached data that YouTube and Afterglow can rebuild.

entries.title: Clear Debug Log
entries.description: Empties the local diagnostic log.

entries.title: Afterglow Control Center
entries.description: The Afterglow hub: Vault, player state, experiments, AI Home, themes, health, and recovery.

entries.title: Afterglow Vault
entries.description: Downloads, imports, thumbnails, collections, and the download queue.

entries.title: AB Lab
entries.description: Browse Cold, Hot, Global and Phenotype experiment flags with profiles and recovery.

entries.title: AI Home Studio
entries.description: Prompt-driven AI Home with saved prompts, quick ideas, and a way back to the normal Home feed.

entries.title: Theme Studio
entries.description: Presets, saved themes, every semantic color, gradient, glow, typography, import, export, and contrast checks.

entries.title: Glow Lab
entries.description: Live glow tuning and previews.
